RWA.note: Document names the NCSA only as the authoriser of cross-border personal data storage; no creation, alert or incident stated.
Authorisation from the NCSA is needed to store personal data abroad; a condition on sending data abroad, not a rule that it must stay.

facts.fact: Rwanda's National Cyber Security Authority is acting as the data protection supervisor under the personal data protection law, authorising storage of personal data outside Rwanda, according to its Data Protection and Privacy Office.

The Data Protection and Privacy Office of the National Cyber Security Authority states that Rwanda's Law relating to the protection of personal data and privacy applies, that compliance is mandatory and that non-compliance can bring financial penalties.
facts.system: Law relating to the protection of personal data and privacy

facts.fact: The National Cyber Security Authority grants the authorisation the data protection law requires for storing personal data outside Rwanda.
